en: Colorized photograph of a mid‑20th‑century European urban square or shopping area. Low, curved strip of shops with large glass windows lines the right and center, beneath yellowish apartment blocks with red mansard roofs. A broad open plaza or roundabout with parked and passing cars (including a yellow car in the foreground) dominates the middle. People walk on the sidewalks and in front of the shops; two women in light dresses cross a path from a grassy park with birch trees on the left. The overall style suggests a modern residential‑commercial district rather than a historic center.
